name: Chingola
pointBasis: UN WUP2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; not a municipal boundary or parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Chingola City Council's official departments page assigns estate management responsibility for processing land applications and maintaining the deeds register; its services page lists plot allocation/town planning and land distribution. The national official NSDI cadastre service identifies its Lots layer as lots from ZILMIS and returned anonymous parcel polygons in a bounded Chingola-area query.
technicalBlocker: A real anonymous polygon service and native OBJECTID were verified, but exact-point lookup returned zero features and citywide coverage, authoritative CRS transformation behavior, stable identity semantics, and adapter contract qualification remain for serial review.
scopeLimits: The three retained polygons are bounded samples from an official national service near the WUP point, not proof of citywide coverage or exact-point parcel presence. No owner, address, titleholder, tax/account, contact, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Zambia NSDI Vector CadasterNew MapServer, Lots layer; service metadata says lots from ZILMIS and national Zambia cadaster/customary lots.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Three complete polygon features were obtained from a 10 km UTM envelope centered on the WUP point; exact WUP-point intersects query returned zero features.

runtimeAssessment.reason: Serial reviewer must independently qualify source-native identity, coverage, CRS, and adapter behavior before admission. Packet completion is not source integration/admission.

queries.query: Chingola Zambia city council land registry cadastral plot map official
queries.scope: Fresh first-party discovery of local registry custody and public cadastral geometry.
queries.result: Official Chingola City Council pages identify estate/deeds-register duties and plot allocation/land distribution. Official Zambia NSDI MapServer search result exposed the CadasterNew Lots layer, described as lots from ZILMIS.
queries.executionMethod: Executed as a fresh web search; first-party council and national service pages were reviewed.

queries.query: Chingola ubutaka registry plot map council Zambia
queries.scope: Separate local-language discovery for city registry/cadastre custody and anonymous parcel geometry.
queries.result: No Bemba-language first-party cadastral page was returned by the search. English first-party Chingola Council and Zambia NSDI results were retained as the relevant official evidence; this is not evidence of source absence.
queries.executionMethod: Executed as a separate fresh web search using Bemba terms; no login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or unsafe-data request was used.

requests.outcome: 200; official MapServer metadata returned national Zambia cadaster/customary lots and layer 0 Lots.

200; polygon layer schema observed. Source spatial reference EPSG:32735 (WGS 84 / UTM zone 35S). Fields included native OBJECTID, UPID, PID, SRREF, survey and land-use fields; only OBJECTID was used for retained samples.
200; empty FeatureCollection at the exact WUP point. This is a point result only and not an absence finding.
200; many polygon features returned with exceededTransferLimit=true. First three complete polygons were retained in chingola-sample.geojson with properties reduced to native OBJECTID identity only.

portals.observation: Official national map/API service; current REST metadata and query route were inspected.
Official local authority portal; custody/service pages reviewed, no city-specific public geometry endpoint identified.

nativeIdentity: SDE.Lots.OBJECTID (numeric ArcGIS OID returned in feature id and source field). UPID was observed but blank in the bounded response and was not promoted.
schemaAndCrs: Layer 0 is esriGeometryPolygon; source spatial reference EPSG:32735. Query responses were requested as GeoJSON with outSR=4326. The retained sample contains full polygon geometry and only canonical properties.id set to the native OBJECTID string.

fieldMapping.retained feature properties: id only, derived from native SDE.Lots.OBJECTID; no raw attribute set retained.
fieldMapping.composite-key provenance: None; no composite identity was created.

retainedProperties: Exactly one canonical native identity per feature: properties.id = string form of SDE.Lots.OBJECTID.
unsafeDataPolicy: No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, legal-description, rights/interests, or other personal/property-record fields were requested or retained.
limits: Exact WUP-point hit was zero; no coordinate was shifted to force a hit.
The bounded envelope query returned more than the service transfer limit; only three full polygons were retained, and no absence or citywide coverage claim is made.
The local council pages evidence custody and land administration, while the national MapServer evidences geometry; these are distinct findings.
Runtime readiness remains held pending independent serial adapter qualification.
uncertainty: The service is official and returned native polygon geometry, but the relationship between national layer extent, Chingola municipal coverage, and exact parcel identity stability requires serial review.
